title: CC charts, crosses and closes a ticket through the ticket machine and CodeMother's gates
intention: CC's one sail helper drafts a ticket's chart and then has the ticket queue itself, by its fileref, at CodeMother's chart, clearance and verdict gates over the bus, with CC as the sender; it imports none of her code, and the three helpers that did (cross.py, chart_ticket.py, verdict_ticket.py) are deleted.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cc_proofs_reach_no_other_device.py tooth test_no_cc_file_imports_another_device reds on cairn/devices/cc/scripts/chart_ticket.py (seven codemother imports) and cairn/devices/cc/scripts/verdict_ticket.py (one), beside cairn/devices/cc/scripts/cross.py (ticket 5e11fadd63b3). Recast 2026-11-11: CodeMother answers no chart verb (26ec04b32637 RETIRED) — each stage is a gate a ticket queues at (fa4462c803d6 PROVED), so the helpers ask the gates, and cross.py (5e11fadd63b3, aimed at the harbor's retired clear) folds in here.
traces_to: RULE 1; outline 9.6 (no chart or verdict verb; cross leaves with the harbor's clear) and 3.3.4.3 (the ticket sends only its fileref), Q#80/Q#81; the cc proof's tooth test_no_cc_file_imports_another_device.
how: One script, cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py, with four verbs: draft (CC's chart spec -> one Ticket.draft per stage), chart (Ticket.chart), cross (no target: Ticket.queueme('clearance'); FIXME or a disposition by name: cairn.tools.base.cross; any other target refused), verdict (a draft from the validate berth's criteria claimed pass, then Ticket.queueme('verdict')). Its participant is an Asker over cairn.tools.bus_client.reach('codemother') stamping sender CC. close.sh and prove.sh call it; cross.py, chart_ticket.py, verdict_ticket.py and 5e11fadd63b3's proof are deleted. A red-first proof drives it with a recording bus over a scratch tickets store.

clauses.claim: cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py imports nothing under cairn.devices, and cairn/devices/cc/scripts/ holds no cross.py, chart_ticket.py or verdict_ticket.py
draft writes chart.<stage> for orient through validate on the plan, each carrying the spec's fields for that stage's door and neither the ticket claim nor any *_ref key

chart sends one request per stage, orient through validate in order, each to codemother, verb machines/<stage>/queueme, sender CC, body exactly {fileref}; a reply with passed false stops it there with exit 1 naming the stage and its lacks
cross with no target sends exactly one request, machines/clearance/queueme with body {fileref}, and prints the workflow the gate answered; a refusal exits 1 with the gate's reason

cross naming a forward target exits 1, sends nothing and changes no ticket file; naming FIXME or a disposition it calls the cross tool with actor CC and the why, proofs and missing given, and sends nothing on the bus

verdict drafts chart.verdict whose verdicts carry every validate criterion's claim and instrument verbatim, outcome pass and the given observation, then sends exactly one request, machines/verdict/queueme with body {fileref}; with no validate berth it exits 1 and sends nothing

close.sh and prove.sh set X to cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py, name no cross.py, and every call of it is exactly 'sail.py cross $ID'; cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cross_asks_the_harbor_over_the_bus.py does not exist

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py: Asker(bus=None) with request/post stamping sender CC and channel personal over reach('codemother'); drafts_of(spec) -> {stage: draft} using chart_ticket.py's field shapes minus ticket and refs; draft, chart, cross, verdict, verdict_draft functions each returning an exit code and taking participant/tickets_dir/crosser for the proof; argparse main. Forward test: canon_target is FIXME or is_disposition, else refused.

D2: close.sh crosses PROVED with 'sail.py cross $ID' (the note rides the commit message; the gate derives the proofs); prove.sh crosses PROVEME with 'sail.py cross $ID'. cross.py, chart_ticket.py and verdict_ticket.py are deleted, and with them cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cross_asks_the_harbor_over_the_bus.py (5e11fadd63b3's red-first proof, aimed at the harbor's clear that outline 9.4.1.5 retired).

D3: the proof cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py, red-first, PROVES 91a27edfdd81 1-6: a scratch tickets store (the live store charter copied in, ticket_file._TICKETS pointed at it), a recording bus behind a real Asker, an injected crosser for clause 5, an AST scan for clause 1; the house runner.
sail.py's Asker now composes DiagnosticBase with a chained super().__init__() (1f2b794a); the sail proof stays 7/7 green

measured.saw: test_no_cc_file_imports_another_device FAIL naming chart_ticket.py:20-58 and verdict_ticket.py:9

a request from sender CC over reach('codemother') to machines/clearance/queueme and machines/orient/queueme with an empty body is answered by the gate itself (accepted false, 'queueme needs a fileref'), so CC reaches the gates over the bus today
the build's hollow reading redded no tooth for close.sh, prove.sh or the deleted test_cross_asks_the_harbor_over_the_bus.py: D2 wrote them and no clause said what they become
